name: Veryk Ship for WooCommerce
author: Verykship

sections.description:
Veryk Ship for WooCommerce is a shipping and label-generation plugin that allows merchants to create shipping labels directly from their WooCommerce store.

After installing the plugin and connecting to your Veryk Ship account, you can generate shipping labels, calculate rates, and sync tracking information back to WooCommerce without leaving the admin panel. This helps streamline order fulfillment and reduce manual shipping work.

The plugin supports multiple major carriers and is designed for merchants shipping within Canada, the US, or cross-border. It is ideal for WooCommerce stores looking for a simple, centralized shipping workflow.

Key Features

  • Integration with multiple major carriers
  • Cloud-based freight forwarding technology
  • Express delivery and freight services
  • Transshipment and warehousing solutions
  • E-commerce supply chain integration
  • Real-time shipping management
  • WooCommerce compatibility

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party/external services to perform currency conversion, shipping rate calculation, shipment creation, and tracking.
Below is a complete list of all external services used, what data is sent, and their policies.

1. Veryk Ship API (https://www.verykship.com/api)

What it is used for:
Core shipping operations, including account verification, rate calculation, order submission, shipment creation, logistics tracking, and generating printable shipping labels.

What data is sent & when:
Sent only when the merchant performs shipping-related actions within WooCommerce:
– Store address
– API key (saved by the merchant)
– Destination address
– Order information (items, weight, dimensions)
– Selected shipping method
– Tracking requests (order ID / tracking number)

Links:
Terms of Service: https://www.verykship.com/en-US/terms-and-conditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.verykship.com/en-US/privacy-policy.html

2. Frankfurter Currency API (https://api.frankfurter.app)

What it is used for:
Currency exchange rate retrieval when shipping calculations require conversion.

What data is sent & when:
Only currency codes (e.g., USD, EUR).
No personal, customer, or order-identifiable data is transmitted.

Links:
Terms of Service: https://www.frankfurter.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.frankfurter.app/privacy

3. Veryk internal service endpoints (https://3hlrnj-shipper.veryk.dev)

What it is used for:
Internal testing/staging service endpoints for development and debugging.

What data is sent & when:
Used only when enabled in development mode.
May send:
– API key
– Shipping origin/destination
– Package details

Links:
Terms of Service: https://3hlrnj-shipper.veryk.dev/en-US/terms-and-conditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://3hlrnj-shipper.veryk.dev/en-US/privacy-policy.html

The plugin does not transmit any unnecessary data, does not send analytics, and does not store data externally beyond what is required for shipping operations.
sections.installation:
1. Search for “Veryk Ship For Woocommerce” in the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin zip file
  2. Install and activate the plugin
  3. Click “Account Opening Entrance” in the plugin details to begin the account application process
  4. Configure Veryk Ship settings after successfully saving the relevant information
  5. Complete the account opening process
  6. In WooCommerce settings, go to the “Shipping” tab, under “Shipping Zones”
  7. Select a zone to edit, click “Add shipping method”, select “Veryk Ship”, and save
sections.faq:
Will a failed shipping order affect the creation of the product order?

No, failed shipping orders do not affect product order creation. For orders where shipping failed, the error reason will be displayed in the order list.

Where can I see the specific error message?

After enabling Debug mode in WordPress, check the error information in wp-content/debug.log file.

What PHP version is required?

Veryk Ship requires PHP 8.0 or higher for optimal performance and security.
